To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the color coordinates are not the same for all light-emitting diode, 2) the color coordinates of the light-emitting diod are different for the different color temperature, 3) the color coordinates for the different light-emitting diods are not the same.

the colorimetric measurements are influenced by the digital filtering of a light-emitting diode signal, and the color coordinates of the light-emitting diods are not always equal for the same perceived color.

the digital filtering of a spectrum of radiation of light-emitting-diode has a significant influence on the quality of received spectrum and colorimetric characteristics; the selection of light-emitting-die for lighting systems is possible on the basis of color coordinates.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method to select light-emitting diode for lighting systems.
the selection of light-emitting devices with similar color characteristics and the reproducibility of colorimetry of light-emitting elements.
the development of a method for the selection of white light-emititing diodes with similar colour characteristics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
digital filters can be applied to light emitting diodes for colorimetric measurements.

the selection of light-emitting-diodes for lighting systems on the basis of color coordinates of their radiation is not enough, and it is also important to consider the influence of the digital filtering of a received signal on the quality and color coordinates of a spectrum of radiation.
the results of this study are very important for the future of lighting systems based on light-emitting diode technology.

the digital signal processing can be applied to measure the color coordinates of LEDs.

the colorimetric measurements can be done in a reliable way by the use of digital filtering of the signal, and it can be used for the selection term of white light-emititing diodes for the lighting system.

the digital filtering of a received signal is a useful method for the analysis of light-emitting devices, but the selection of light-emitting-diodes for lighting systems should be based on the colorimetric measurements.

the selection of light-emitting devices for lighting systems should be carried out with consideration of the spectral characteristics of the devices and the influence of the digital filtering on the quality of color measurements.
the use of the digital signal filter in the colorimetric measurements allows to improve the quality of the received spectra and to reduce the measurement error.
the use of digital filtering for the measurement of the color coordinates of LEDs is a promising direction of research.
